sum: Gives each agent a container and a separate branch, so they run in parallel.

evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 1 of the 5 neutral interface standards (AGENTS.md)
evidence.se.residency: cites data_residency: local-first, the operator's state stays on their machine; keys are the operator's own (byok)
evidence.se.threats: cites th and ctrl: T4 introduced, controls sandbox impl, egress part, limits part, log part, kill part
evidence.sf.reach: restates exec and ctrl: the entry executes, and its reach is bounded by sandbox impl
evidence.co.coexist: states the hosts it sits beside: Claude Code, Cursor, Amazon Q, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Zed, OpenCode, Cline, Kilo Code, OpenAI Codex (README.md)
evidence.ic.help: a command-line parser that prints its own usage: go.mod (cobra)
evidence.fx.install: only a global install is documented: README.md (brew install )
evidence.fx.byo: the entry does not call a model provider itself, so there is no provider for the operator to substitute
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format environment: the container is the tool's own and does not outlive it. The work it holds lands on a git branch, which git reads without the tool (README: git checkout <branch_name>)

gnote: One of the few layers that directly mitigates tool misuse and privilege compromise (T2/T3)

ja.sum: エージェントごとにコンテナと分離ブランチを与え、並列に走らせる。
ja.gnote: T2/T3の緩和に直接効く数少ない層

steps: エージェントが環境を要求
コンテナとブランチを作成
人がブランチをレビュー

steps.s: Create a container and a branch
